newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR ENDS AT LOWS AFTER EARLIER RALLY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR ENDS AT LOWS AFTER EARLIER RALLY.

text.p: White sugar futures reverted to their downward trend in late trading on Thursday and closed at session lows.
Benchmark October closed down $1.70 at $323.00 support after reaching up to an intraday peak of $326.00. December ended $1.20 lower at $320.50 and volume totalled a solid 2,210 lots.
After New York opened, bargain-hunters of the sliding October/October premium supported the nearby whites contract after persistent trade selling had pressured the differential down to around $65.
